name: Mateo Ferreira
bio: Runs the opening stint. Keeps the car clean when the pack is not.

name: Dane Kowalczyk
bio: Prototype specialist. Fastest when the track goes green at 3am.

name: Ines Marchetti
bio: Qualifying driver. Builds a lap out of three corners and a tow.

name: Rhys Callaghan
bio: Double stints without a complaint. Talks to the pitwall like an engineer.

name: Colt Vandermeer
bio: Short track closer. Saves the tyres nobody else remembered to save.

name: Shay Okonkwo
bio: Reads a pack better than the spotter. Rarely out of the top ten.

name: Priya Raghunathan
bio: Owns the strategy call and the fuel number behind it.

name: Tomas Ek
bio: Builds the entry list, the driver rotation and the practice calendar.
